test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

When did they find the mistake?

options.text: When has the mistake been found?

solution:
The correct answer is: **When was the mistake found?**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.
 
• The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.
 
• The preposition “by” is used before the object made in Passive Voice. However, it is optional in some cases.
 
• The question in Active voice is an **interrogative sentence**.
 
• The format of the sentence which has “Did” in Active voice is: **When + Did + Subject + V1 + Object?**
 
• Therefore, in Passive voice, the format will be: **When + Was/Were + Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).**
 
• For example:
 
 
• Did he beat you? (Active)
 
• Were you beaten by him? (Passive)
 
 
 
• The options except (1) don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is: ***When was the mistake found?***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__***

 
• There are two verbs:
 
• **Find- found - found** (discover or perceive by chance or unexpectedly.) (Transitive verb)
 
 
• He found a solution to the problem
 
 
 
• **Found- founded - founded **(establish or originate (an institution or organization).) (transitive verb)
 
 
• Example- The town was founded by English settlers in 1790.
